profile.headline: 3x Salesforce Marketing Cloud Certified Professional | Marketing Cloud Developer | I help companies get the most out of Marketing Cloud | TalentStacker Salesforce Professional Development Program
profile.jobTitle: Sr. Software Engineer, Salesforce Marketing Cloud
profile.summary:
I’m an experienced software engineer with 15+ years of experience in Salesforce and Marketing Cloud.

I spent 7 years creating and sending emails for clients in the retail and agricultural industries. I also spent another 7 years as a Salesforce customer success consultant working directly for Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

I’m skilled in Web Design, HTML, CSS, C#, XML, SQL, Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

In the last 15+ years, I’ve accumulated a vast knowledge of email best practices and email marketing trends.

I have a bachelors in Computer and Information Technology from Purdue University.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Salesforce Marketing Cloud
Salesforce Marketing Cloud Technical Architect
positions.description:
- Translated client goals and challenges into scalable Marketing Cloud deliverables
- Effectively communicated and presented the design, positive impacts, and limitations of proposed solutions to customers
- Management of project scope through accurate documentation of requirements
positions.insights: Skills: Marketing Automation · Problem Solving · Microsoft Excel

positions.title: Technical Specialist
positions.description:
▪ Diagnosed and resolved complex bugs within customer Marketing Cloud and Salesforce CRM solutions, including
Marketing Cloud automations and query activities and Salesforce CRM Flows.
▪ Created troubleshooting playbooks, procedure playbooks, and comparative analyses of AppExchange solutions to guide team's growth.
▪ Triaged and provided live solutions to complex customer problems while on customer calls.
▪ Participated in discovery calls and turned customers’ user stories and requirements into architectural solutions in
Marketing Cloud.
▪ Provided technical guidance and oversight during customer migration from Eloqua to Marketing Cloud, including migrating emails and building IP Warming audiences.
▪ Helped with Marketing Cloud implementations and advanced query and automation design
positions.insights: Skills: Marketing Automation · Problem Solving · HTML · JavaScript · SQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Flows · Microsoft Excel · Analytical Skills · Salesforce CRM · AMPscript · Salesforce Marketing Cloud

positions.title: Software Engineer, Customer Centric Engineering
positions.description:
- Completed Trailhead Trails training on salesforce development, enabling delivery of  higher-level enterprise software support.
- Conducted troubleshooting of complex bugs within multiple Salesforce Marketing Cloud applications, maintaining and creating troubleshooting playbooks for internal use to triage client reported issues more efficiently.
- Led support enablement sessions to improve triage issue resolution process.
- Presented reports on health of  Salesforce Marketing Cloud applications to scrum teams.
- Collaborated with scrum team owner on bulk contract with processing issues; led initiative to fast-track issue resolution process by communicating across departments to address importance of quick resolution.  
- Worked with Windows team on root cause analysis to resolve issue impacting client email subscribers; conducted in-depth analysis of issues, including testing, and resolved problem with minimal impact to client.
positions.insights: Skills: Marketing Automation · Problem Solving · JavaScript · Microsoft Excel · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Web Programmer
positions.description:
- Responsible for various components of web design and maintenance
- Development of websites using HTML, CSS, jQuery, AJAX, XML, XHTML
- Development of websites as part of a team using ASP.Net as a platform
- Designing of Emails using HTML, CSS, AmpScript that go out through ExactTarget/Salesforce Marketing Cloud
- Using SQL to pull data from a database to show on various web apps
- Testing websites that were developed and documenting the findings of those test
- Resolved new and existing customer issues and application bugs, developed websites, and analyzed web data.
- Resolved loading issue for new customer by working with customer to identify and address root cause as browser level.
- Challenged by president of company to update existing website; exceeded expectations by recoding the site using C# and jQuery to present a sliding image on the homepage. 
- Improved customer experience after taking over project to build a last minute website prior to new promotion/launch; delivered site in less than 48 hours.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · JavaScript · Microsoft Excel · Analytical Skills
